findings.root_cause: A failed research run could be retried while a newer run of the same workflow was active, bypassing one-active-run lineage.
findings.repair: Retry checks other active runs in the same immediate write transaction and refuses overlap with HTTP 409.

findings.root_cause: Idempotent enqueue reported queued even when returning an already-running run.
findings.repair: The enqueue response reads the actual persisted status.

findings.root_cause: Untyped nested workflow params allowed numeric/object symbols and list/object ranges to raise AttributeError/TypeError and HTTP 500.
findings.repair: Validate nested symbol and range/interval value types before symbol normalization or membership tests; preserve HTTP 422 and save no invalid plan.

findings.root_cause: Read-only model tool results were truncated as raw JSON strings, producing invalid JSON for valid large evidence and unbounded full-result durable receipts.
findings.repair: Bound both provider messages and receipts with one valid JSON envelope carrying omitted status, full payload byte count, SHA256 and a bounded preview.

findings.root_cause: Malformed model provider response shapes raised AttributeError outside the sanitized failure path and did not update reasoning health.
findings.repair: Validate top-level, usage, choices/message and tool-call shapes before access, deny malformed replies through the bounded recorded failure path.

findings.root_cause: Resolved alerts retained old acknowledgement timestamps on recurrence, and acknowledged warnings remained acknowledged when escalating to critical.
findings.repair: Reopen recurrence/escalation, clear obsolete acknowledgement and preserve the same deduplication identity.

findings.root_cause: The feed collector accepted Atom documents but searched only RSS item elements, silently discarding Atom entries.
findings.repair: Parse declared Atom entries, alternate links and published/updated timestamps; preserve UTC time, raw publisher date and source/content hashes.

findings.root_cause: Lab.apply trusted set_book post-commit response snapshots; a concurrent newer operator policy could be mistaken for the proposal effect, allowing rollback to overwrite the operator update.
findings.repair: Resolve the committed policy hash from the exact proposal actor/token history in the settlement transaction; rollback remains bound to that proposal hash.

findings.root_cause: An exception reading the response after a policy commit reset the applied proposal to approved, permitting a second application with a wrong before-policy.
findings.repair: On response failure inspect exact committed actor/token history; an existing write enters observing, and retry is idempotent without another policy version.

findings.root_cause: A DeskError after a committed rollback reset its stage to observing; later retries conflicted with the already-restored policy and could not finish the decision record.
findings.repair: Inspect exact rollback actor history before resetting observation; committed restoration completes once and never replays over a newer operator policy.

findings.root_cause: Concurrent callers of the same Worker.run_once instance could both claim its running step, call the model twice and append two handoffs for one step.
findings.repair: A nonblocking per-instance tick mutex serializes both resident and direct callers, preserving one committed step effect.

findings.root_cause: The fixed 45-second task/worker leases were not renewed at model inspection and receipt boundaries, so a legitimate multi-round review with slower local evidence expired and retried unnecessarily.
findings.repair: Read/receipt boundaries atomically renew both fences only after validating ownership, active expiry and absence of cancellation. Expired or cancelled work never reclaims authority.

findings.root_cause: Shutdown released worker ownership after its join timeout while the operational thread was still executing an annotation.
findings.repair: Shutdown leaves an in-flight tick fenced; that tick releases its own leases when it exits. Starting the still-live stopped thread cannot clear its stop flag, and direct ticks refuse to reclaim.

findings.root_cause: The model HTTP timeout originally bounded socket operations rather than the entire exchange; a continuously dribbling response could stall a provider call. The first async repair also used asyncio.run, whose DNS executor shutdown could outlive the request deadline.
findings.repair: Route completions through shared bounded_http with POST, the complete 15-second exchange deadline, max 512000 bytes and redirects disabled. The shared cancellable IO loop and fixed four daemon resolver threads avoid per-request DNS executor teardown; cancellation cannot send a late request. Model payload/auth, usage receipts, response bounds and proxy/CA environment trust are preserved.

findings.root_cause: The manual-ledger accountant replayed fills ordered by wall-clock timestamp; a valid buy followed by a sale after the clock moved backwards was reconstructed as a sale before ownership and falsely failed reconciliation.
findings.repair: Replay the immutable fill ledger in durable rowid append order; keep recorded timestamps as evidence without allowing them to reorder accounting effects.

findings.root_cause: Research urllib fetching only bounded each socket wait; a continuously producing response could keep a collection job alive beyond the declared timeout.
findings.repair: Use the shared bounded_http GET transport with an 8-second complete-exchange deadline, 2,000,000-byte limit and read redirects; reject non-2xx without exposing provider bodies and preserve injected fixture transports.

verification.command: ASTER_DB_PATH=<isolated import database> .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_cognitive_agents tests.test_backend tests.test_lab tests.test_research_workflows -v
verification.fixtures: Temporary SQLite databases; in-process model and source transport fixtures; no broker request or external message delivery

checked_invariants: No registered strategy or model financial mutation tool.
Worker lock/task lease fences, durable handoff recovery, cancellation and bounded attempts.
Read-only cognitive tool selection, denied mutations/nonempty args, independent role receipts.
Immutable preregistration, append-only results/source receipts/artifacts/local inbox and monotonic reader cursors.
Proposal stage/token/CAS and exact actor history recovery preserve newer operator policy.
Earlier-only bounded research DAG dependencies, serialized run nodes, cancellation fences, stale history failure, retry receipt lineage.
Source time, raw source evidence, hash and repository blob/commit pins remain explicit.
Same-owner tick re-entry cannot duplicate model calls or agent handoffs.
Evidence and receipt boundaries renew only valid uncancelled leases; slow two-round reviews complete without needless retries.
Stopped in-flight thread cannot clear its stop flag or relinquish valid ownership before exit.
The whole model HTTP exchange has a bounded async deadline and closes cancelled streams/clients, with trust_env retaining configured proxy/CA.
The manual accountant reconstructs buy/sell ownership and exact cents in immutable append order even when wall-clock timestamps regress.
Research reads preserve transport injection and source User-Agent while the shared HTTP helper enforces complete-exchange deadlines, redirects and response limits.
Model completions use the same shared bounded transport as research; DNS executor cleanup cannot extend the caller deadline or resume a cancelled HTTP request.
limits: Review and adversarial regression coverage are not a formal proof that every possible bug is absent.
No live configured LLM or SEC transport was exercised; protocol behavior was tested with isolated fixtures.
Local peer inbox has no remote GitHub sync/threading capability; no external inbox append was performed in this audit.
Strategies remain absent, and neither profitability nor benchmark outperformance is claimed.
Synthetic fixture evidence is used only in tests and was never written to the default live desk database.

supplemental_cross_component_reads.scope: Shared HTTP helper integration and fixed resolver resource/cancellation contract; implementation and transport regressions owned and verified independently by root
